# SafeToL2Setup

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/04c494d92ce87df3b9ba252c17541e08e28fdf97/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/libraries/SafeToL2Setup.sol)

**Inherits:** [SafeStorage](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/libraries/contract.SafeStorage)

**Title:** Safe to L2 Setup Contract

<i>

This contract expects the singleton to be the [Safe](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/contract.Safe) by default. Even if there are more
[SafeL2](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/contract.SafeL2) proxies deployed, the average gas cost on L2s is significantly lower, making the
current design more economically efficient overall.

</i>

This contract facilitates the deployment of a Safe to the same address on all networks by
        automatically changing the singleton to the L2 version when not on chain ID 1.

## Constants

### SELF

<i>

Address of the contract.
     This is used to ensure that the contract is only ever `DELEGATECALL`-ed.

</i>

```solidity
address private immutable SELF;
```

## Functions

<a id="constructor"></a>

### constructor

Initializes a new [SafeToL2Setup](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/libraries/contract.SafeToL2Setup) instance.

```solidity
constructor();
```

<a id="onlydelegatecall"></a>

### onlyDelegateCall

Modifier ensure a function is only called via `DELEGATECALL`. Will revert otherwise.

```solidity
modifier onlyDelegateCall();
```

<a id="onlynoncezero"></a>

### onlyNonceZero

Modifier to prevent using initialized Safes.

```solidity
modifier onlyNonceZero();
```

<a id="onlycontract-address"></a>

### onlyContract

Modifier to ensure that the specified account is a contract.

```solidity
modifier onlyContract(address account);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| account | `address` |  |

<a id="setuptol2-address"></a>

### setupToL2

Setup the Safe with the provided L2 singleton if needed.

<i>

This function checks that the chain ID is not 1, and if it isn't updates the singleton
     to the provided L2 singleton.

</i>

```solidity
function setupToL2(address l2Singleton) external onlyDelegateCall onlyNonceZero onlyContract(l2Singleton);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| l2Singleton | `address` |  |
